title: Clear stale prepend gap after shrink-to-bottom clamp
outcome: Broadening bottom-landing clamp classification to include content shrink also skips pendingPrependedBottomGapRef clearing and user-scroll-kind classification. After an upward escape, a shrink can clamp the reader to bottom while retaining a stale pre-shrink gap; the next older-history prepend may replay that gap and jump the viewport. Preserve the correct side effects independently of passive-tail-follow classification and update the stale isBottomLandingClamp contract comment.
acceptance: A handler-level regression arms a prepend gap, applies a shrink-to-bottom clamp, and proves no stale gap is replayed on the next prepend. Tail-follow remains correct and the parameter documentation matches shrink-inclusive behavior.
